label: CA near-ring interpretation
title: Groovy is a missing distributive law in the cellular-automaton near-ring
summary: Known near-ring theory supplies the nonlinear algebra of cellular automata. Groovy's polarization is exactly the missing distributivity term, and Rules 4/200 generate a four-element Boolean ring inside the nonlinear CA near-ring.
takeaway: Linear cellular automata form the ring-like core; Groovy measures one dynamically selected failure of the distributive law lost outside that core.
